title: Machine learning-based screening and validation of liver metastasis-specific genes in colorectal cancer.
summary: The primary study uses several ML feature-selection methods to identify colorectal liver-metastasis-associated genes and evaluates the selected genes/model in independent datasets. This is an exploratory association, not evidence that the genes cause metastasis.
